scope: Same-dispatch binding for ID14 header clip_gain_index and sequence_count; no new numeric rule

clock_identity.F04RB: frontend callback g>=2; receiver r=g-2; receiver after generation r+1
clock_identity.F05J: dispatch d=g-1; zero-based model callback=d+1; codec source s=d-1
clock_identity.join: For this selected route r=s=d-1 and receiver after generation=d; keep these typed clock domains distinct and verify the explicit equations plus same programme/attempt/transaction.

clip_gain_index.producer: Same-dispatch F04D descriptor-after projection consumed by F04RB/F05JC
clip_gain_index.value: F04RB output clip_index equals descriptor selected_index; U8 in 128..255
clip_gain_index.validation: PG03 gain at selected_index-128 must match the exact descriptor target-gain F32 bits. If index is recovered by exact gain reverse lookup, exactly one table match is required; use explicit selected index where available.

sequence_count.owner: Existing F05J/F05JL sequence_counter in the current programme/attempt dispatch state
sequence_count.before_dispatch: counter I16 range -1..1023; wire sequence is 0 if counter<0 else counter
sequence_count.retry: All representation, capacity and Huffman trials for this dispatch reuse the same sequence value and do not advance state.
sequence_count.success: After the complete ID14 body passes capacity/padding/hash checks, next counter is 1 if old counter is 1023 else old counter+1; successful_dispatches increments exactly once.
sequence_count.failure: Failed attempt/final body failure advances neither sequence_counter nor successful_dispatches.
sequence_count.wire: U10 bits[20,30), parse-back must equal the same dispatch proposal.

minimal_private_header_input: F05JL dispatch/source and expected zero-based callback
F05JL sequence before-state/proposal and provider/profile lineage
typed_join.producer: Build the complete header-input value inside the trusted F05JL coordinator after receiver/F04D fitting and sequence prepare. Do not expose independent raw clip_gain_index/sequence_count constructor arguments to a production F13/JOC composer.
identity_checks: F04RB descriptor generation equals dispatch d
receiver r=d-1 and frontend callback g=d+1 according to typed maps
JOC source s=d-1 matches this dispatch
sequence input is current committed before-state and next_dispatch is d
typed_join.F13_handoff: F13 consumes the complete immutable ID14 body plus its existing writer-generation receipt. F13 does not independently choose or update clip_gain_index or sequence_count; do not recalculate from F13 source/AU index.

prewriter_reject: descriptor target gain mismatch against PG03
sequence counter outside -1..1023 or dispatch not next
admission_and_failures.commit: Only existing F05JL successful body stage proposes the next sequence state. The enclosing parent transaction admits it once; later F13 queue/AU publication remains a distinct clock and commit.
admission_and_failures.status: The base producer clauses supply the values and formulas. This package only binds their same-dispatch identity.

no_user_input: clip_gain_index and sequence_count are derived from existing F04D/F05JL owners; no new XML/UI input.
